title: Binance Adds BTC/PLN, ETH/PLN & BUSD/PLN Trading Pairs
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will open trading for BTC/PLN, ETH/PLN and BUSD/PLN trading pairs at  2022-10-19 06:00 (UTC) . Please note: The Polish zloty (PLN) is a fiat currency and does not represent any other digital currencies. Thanks for your support! Binance Team 2022-10-18   Trade on-the-go with Binance’s crypto trading app (iOS/Android) Find us on  Telegram:  https://t.me/binanceexchange Twitter:  https://twitter.com/binance Facebook:  https://www.facebook.com/binance   Instagram:  https://www.instagram.com/binance   Note: This announcement was last updated on 2022-10-18 to delay the trading start time for BTC/PLN, ETH/PLN and BUSD/PLN trading pairs from 2022-10-19 04:00 (UTC) to 2022-10-19 06:00 (UTC).
